summary: Tested new checkin count feature (backend endpoint + homepage badge). All 5 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend badge renders '30' inside Check In button, polls /api/checkins/count on page load, and clicking navigates to /checkin. No regressions in /api/checkin/{location_slug}.
critical_code_review_comments: LinkTreeHomePage.jsx uses window.location.origin for API URL — consistent with rest of file but ideally should use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL constant. Not blocking.
get_active_checkin_count purges expired docs on every call — cheap now but if traffic scales, consider a TTL index on expires_at (Mongo native TTL) instead of delete_many on each request.
Duplicate-ish endpoints exist: /api/checkins/count (new, all/optional slug) and /api/checkin/count/{location_slug} (older). Consider deprecating one to reduce API surface.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 30 active check-ins in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/checkins/count returns {count:int, location_slug:str|null}. Placed before /checkin/{location_slug} to avoid route-matching. Homepage polls every 30s and renders data-testid='checkin-count-badge' inside data-testid='checkin-btn' when count>0. Verified count=30 (global), 29 (edgewood-atlanta) at test time.
